description: Restructure the repository: rename model-rag-local/ to legacy/ via git mv, create the agent/ package skeleton (config.py, tools.py, rag/ subpackage), create requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, .env.example, scripts/, and the myagent shell script. This lays the file structure that FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on.
steps: Run `git mv model-rag-local legacy` in /home/mahdsip/Software/llm to rename the old Docker project. Commit this rename separately so history is preserved.

Create agent/config.py: reads MYAGENT_MODEL (default qwen2.5-coder:14b), OLLAMA_HOST (default http://localhost:11434), RAG_BACKEND (default faiss), RAG_DOCS_DIR (default ./docs), FAISS_INDEX_DIR (default .rag_index/faiss), QDRANT_URL (default http://localhost:6333), QDRANT_COLLECTION (default myagent_docs), EMBEDDING_MODEL (default nomic-embed-text). Defines MODELS = {'qwen': 'qwen2.5-coder:14b', 'deepseek': 'deepseek-r1:32b'}. Uses python-dotenv to load .env if present.

Create requirements.txt with pinned versions: strands-agents[ollama]==0.2.1, faiss-cpu==1.9.0, sentence-transformers==3.3.1, qdrant-client==1.11.1, llama-index-core==0.11.23, llama-index-llms-ollama==0.3.3, llama-index-embeddings-ollama==0.3.0, llama-index-vector-stores-qdrant==0.3.0, python-dotenv==1.0.1.
Create pyproject.toml: minimal PEP 517 config ([build-system] requires=[setuptools], [project] name=myagent requires-python=>=3.11, dependencies read from requirements.txt).
Create .env.example documenting all env vars from config.py with comments in Spanish.
Create scripts/install.sh: checks if ollama is on PATH; if not, runs `curl -fsSL https://ollama.ai/install.sh | sh`; then runs `pip install -r requirements.txt`. Make executable.
Create scripts/pull-models.sh: runs `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:14b` then `ollama pull deepseek-r1:32b` with echo progress. Make executable.

Create myagent shell script at repo root: sets SCRIPT_DIR via `$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)`, sets PYTHONPATH=$SCRIPT_DIR, loads .env if present, execs `python -m agent.main "$@"`. chmod +x myagent.

Create docker-compose.yml with two services both under `profiles: [optional]`: qdrant (adapted from legacy/docker-compose.yml qdrant service, same image, ports 6333/6334, volume ./qdrant_data, healthcheck) and openwebui (ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main, port 3000:8080). No ollama, ragapi, or agentsvc services.
Update README.md placeholder: add a one-paragraph note that the repo is being redesigned, linking to legacy/ for the old Docker system. (Full README rewrite is in FEAT-003.)
acceptance_criteria: git log shows a commit with the rename model-rag-local -> legacy
`python -c 'from agent.config import MODELS, RAG_BACKEND; print(MODELS)'` prints {'qwen': 'qwen2.5-coder:14b', 'deepseek': 'deepseek-r1:32b'}
`docker compose config` validates docker-compose.yml without errors
File myagent exists, is executable (`ls -la myagent` shows -rwxr-xr-x or similar)
verification: python -c 'from agent.config import MODELS, RAG_BACKEND; print(MODELS)'
findings: python-dotenv is available as python3-dotenv==1.0.1 via apt on Ubuntu 24.04 (matching the pinned version in requirements.txt). No pip binary present in the base system — the install.sh script will install pip via curl/ollama installer or the user will need a venv. docker compose config could not be run (Docker not installed on this machine); YAML was validated with Python yaml.safe_load instead — structure confirmed correct (two services: qdrant and openwebui, both with profiles: [optional]). `python` binary not in PATH; verification commands updated to use python3.
